hooks.text: Nearly 200 men at the Alamo faced a blood-red flag.
Why did a blood-red flag wave over the 1836 Alamo?
A blood-red flag in 1836 promised death to every defender.

title: How Did the Alamo Fall in About 90 Minutes?
description: Thirty-two men from Gonzales reached the Alamo during its 13-day siege. On March 6, 1836, about 1,800 Mexican troops stormed its damaged defenses; the final assault lasted no more than 90 minutes. Later paintings in the video are labeled as later depictions.

better_than_last: I focused on the contrast between the 13-day siege and the 90-minute massacre to maximize the twist's impact.
